template_placeholders_policy: This template gate may describe placeholder field names.
This template gate must not fill actual operator identity.
This template gate must not create a real operator_confirmation_id.
This template gate must not create a real confirmation_timestamp_utc.
This template gate must not create a real confirmation_expiry_utc.
This template gate must not include an operator acknowledgement value of true.
This template gate must not state confirmation completed.
A future result task must replace placeholders only in a separately authorized operator-confirmation collection task.
expiration_policy: A future completed confirmation result must include confirmation_timestamp_utc and confirmation_expiry_utc.
A future confirmation expiry must be explicit UTC.
A future confirmation must be rejected if missing, expired, or not auditably tied to the accepted target/source commit.
This template gate does not start any expiry clock.
